description: The boss room placer finds the StructureStart of a Phantom Catacombs and places room_7 and the boss room without falling back. The placer only runs for structures within 8 chunks of a player and checks every 600 ticks, so the player waits next to the catacombs for over a minute. A fallback or a failed placement logs a WARN or an ERROR, which fails the server-log check. The player enters the dimension at 0 0 first so the Time Keeper Village is not placed on the catacombs.

steps.command: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run locate structure chronodawn:phantom_catacombs

steps: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run spreadplayers 0 0 0 1 false ${player}
execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run spreadplayers ${x} ${z} 0 1 false ${player}

steps.note: The ground above a Phantom Catacombs (its start is at x=${x}, z=${z}), seen straight down from 30 blocks up. The catacombs are underground, so this shot only shows that the area loaded. The check that matters is the server log: no WARN or ERROR from the boss room placer.
